data.name: Carpus
data.gender_notes: Carpus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word κάρπος (karpos), meaning fruit, or fruitful. In the New Testament, Carpus is mentioned as one of the seven deacons appointed by the apostles to help with the distribution of food and other resources to the needy members of the early Christian community. The name Carpus carries the meaning “Fruitful, bearing fruit” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carpus usually hope their child will grow to embody fruitful, bearing fruit and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes growth and nourishment, both materially and spiritually.
data.etymology: Carpus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fruitful, bearing fruit.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carpus total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_greek.name: Κάρπος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Κάρπος είναι ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει φίλος και συγγενής, και αναφέρεται στη Καινή Διαθήκη ως πρόσωπο που ήταν κοντά στον Απόστολο Павλο και ήταν μέλος της πρώτης χριστιανικής κοινότητας

in_latin.name: Carpus
in_latin.long_meaning: Carpus est nomen Latinum quod significat amicum et proximum, et in Nova Testamenta mentionem habet ut persona quae erat propinqua Apostolo Paulo et erat pars primae communitatis Christianae

in_english.name: Carpus
in_english.long_meaning: Carpus is a name that means dear friend and close companion, and it is mentioned in the New Testament as a person who was close to the Apostle Paul and was part of the early Christian community

data.cultural_impact: The name Carpus signifies a person who is productive and fruitful, not only in the literal sense of bearing children and producing crops, but also in the metaphorical sense of being a contributor to the community and making a positive impact in the world. This name would have resonated with early Christians, who valued hard work, generosity, and selflessness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Carpus is a reminder of the importance of living a fruitful and productive life in the eyes of God. This can be achieved by serving others, spreading the message of love and compassion, and striving for personal growth and spiritual development. The name also emphasizes the importance of being a good steward of the resources and blessings that have been given to us, and using them to make a difference in the lives of those around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Carpus is a Greek name meaning "wrist" or "arm." In a spiritual or symbolic sense, it may represent strength, support, or protection, as the wrist and arms are integral parts of our physical framework that enable us to carry out tasks and shield ourselves. In Christianity, Carpus may also symbolize the faith and steadfastness of Saint Carpus, a martyr who was one of the Seven Boys of Ephesus.
